title: The gBCE loss as a drop-in replacement for SASRec's BCE
notes: CORRECTED. Now matches package gbce_loss(pos_scores, neg_scores, pos_mask, num_items, t=0.75): adds the pos_mask parameter, multiplies per-position loss by pos_mask.float(), and averages over masked target positions only (per_position.sum()/pos_mask.float().sum().clamp(min=1.0)). Resolves the printed 3-arg signature drift and the self-contradiction with Listing 6.5's 4-arg call. Self-contained (imports torch.nn.functional); exec of the def PASSES.
